issues.title: Cambodia protests Thai installation of Buddha statue in Anlong Veng
issues.title_en: Cambodia protests Thai installation of Buddha statue in Anlong Veng
issues.summary: PHNOM PENH: The Cambodian government has lodged a strong formal protest against what it described as "continued violations of Cambodia's sovereignty and territorial integrity" by Thai forces along the border, most recently through the installation of a large Buddha statue in Oddar Meanchey province.

issues.title: Campus shooter who killed three in southern Philippines had planned attack, warned classmates: Mayor
issues.title_en: Campus shooter who killed three in southern Philippines had planned attack, warned classmates: Mayor
issues.summary: BANGA, Philippines: The 16-year-old student who allegedly went on a shooting rampage at Banga National High School in southern Philippines on Sept 18 had planned the attack as early as August and had warned some classmates hours before carrying it out, according to Mayor Albert Palencia.

issues.title_en: Gun in South Cotabato school shooting traced to Philippines Department of Education employee

issues.title: Cambodian PM highlights ‘hundreds of millions’ spent to cushion economic impact of Iran conflict
issues.title_en: Cambodian PM highlights ‘hundreds of millions’ spent to cushion economic impact of Iran conflict
issues.summary: PHNOM PENH: Cambodia has incurred hundreds of millions of dollars in losses from the economic impact of the conflict in the Middle East, including through state subsidies and measures to contain rising fuel prices, while the government is expecting to spend millions more to support other affected groups, notably including tuk-tuk drivers.
